summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Shared player, NPC, loot, combat and presentation systems support those levels; Level 11's B.N.T.G. house sale leads to a separately built, furnished 2000s green-house interior with usable appliances, storage and entertainment.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, shifting walls and hunters, with generated Manila sanctuary, M.E.G. waypoint, lore props and noclip seam.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones, agents and set pieces.
places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators and lifts; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; office structure/residents and hotel encounters, including Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level6, places/level61 (3D) - Lights Out and Snackrooms; Level 6.1 food-court shops, service, vending and Camp Amber connect onward to Level 11.

places/level7, places/level8 (3D) - ocean, Seawatch and Fort Surrender; cave systems on the 9th Road with camp survivors, traders and surveyors; places/debug is a test atmosphere and places/spamton a basement showroom/boss arena.

places/level10 (3D, Bumper Crop) - heightmapped farm and M.E.G. Outpost Bountiful: farmhouse, barn, fields, well, oven, wheat, quest NPCs and lake dock/tackle cache; lake-deep exit to Level 7 and roads to Level 11.

places/level11 and places/home11 (3D) - Infinite City districts, canal, shops and quests; B.N.T.G. Realty sells the green house, which transfers to a separate living room/bedroom/hall/bathroom/kitchen home with interactive fixtures and a packable tote.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template and HUD, routing, and an eight-player cap; Backspace opens the main menu.

templates/player.js + templates/camera.js; scripts/camera.js - ordered player behavior chain and camera entry, owning presented yaw/pitch and eye position; first-person eye height uses camera.yml and switches to critterEye; scripts/view3.js supplies third person.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick local behavior, generally sleeping when empty.
sim.js - world cadence and onOutOfBounds referee; players return true for normal respawn, creatures with state.home return home, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
places/level10/sim.js - lays terrain-relative Bumper Crop scenery, outpost NPCs/props, wheat, lake dock and tackle cache, exits and ambience.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js - Level 11 city/street assembler and local behavior; generated city, shop and Realty office, house-sale sign and purchasable house exterior.
places/home11/sim.js - versioned interior builder (V=34); builds a furnished green house with hallway and bathroom, restores owner's fridge and reconstructs moved/packed props.
scripts/home11-door.js - home press handler for exit, hinged doors, tote packing/placement, bed, TV/radio, lamps, fridge replenishment, microwave and phone.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by simulations, geometry, labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes/faces data - seeded coats, face traits and expressions plus rendered heads/bodies/garments; mask children are attached from garment rows.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers; player inventory handling accepts fishing catch tokens and fish meat.
scripts/lib/combat.js + scripts/lib/data/combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules used by player and NPC combat.

scripts/lib/condition.js + condition.yml, difficulty.yml and scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon/armor condition, balance multipliers and derived handling/carry values used by player, clothes, loot UI and NPC behavior.

scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav - shared NPC path search budget/cache and body radius; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml choose surface clips; scripts/lib/photo2006.js supplies common photographic look finishing.

scripts/lib/data/tv-channels.yml + scripts/lib/data/snacks.yml + scripts/lib/items.js - home CRT media definitions and microwave food values; scripts/player.js exports pullToken for inventory drops and storage deposits.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick; places/spamton/sim.js - cadence, tick.

places/level10/sim.js and places/level184/sim.js - cadence and tick; scripts/terrain10.js and scripts/terrain184.js - heightAt, materialAt; scripts/barn10.js, farmhouse10.js, props10.js and props11.js - geometry/collider builders.
places/home11/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/home11-door.js - ding and ears.press for home interactions; scripts/level10-use.js - ears.press for farm props.
scripts/lib/level10-quests.js - QUESTS10, setWheatStep, setWatcherStep, setCellarStep, finishQuest, handleDialogueQuest10; scripts/lib/fishing.js - water checks, fishing lifecycle and loot helpers.

scripts/bobber.js - onSpawn, updateSchedule, update, cleanup; scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, pullToken, useSnack, onInput and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance.
scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects; scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update.
scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/level11-elevator.js - updateSchedule, callElevator, ears, update.
scripts/loot-ui.js - lootUi; scripts/interact.js - openLoot, talk, ears, onInput, update; scripts/home11-door.js loads TV channels/snacks and exports asynchronous ding handler.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing, karma/rep and level access; pullToken removes one carried token for dropping or fridge storage.

scripts/lib/fishing.js - player.state.fishingState session (bobber id, target coordinates, water/place/depth, phase and cast power), canonical water checks, bite/reel outcome and location-based loot selection; scripts/player.js handles session input.
scripts/bobber.js - spawned bobber's owner/water/phase state and physical float, twitch and plunge behavior; destroys itself when its owner/session is no longer valid.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; initialize/migrate/spend points, derive carry/combat values and tick companion perks.
scripts/craft.js - craft actions, recipe costs/outputs/skills/bench gating, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; scripts/swim.js owns swimming/underwater/breath and swim session controls.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - player focus, loot and sit state; interact.js owns lootOpen/lootList/lootStore and writes storage contents to player.state[saveKey] when configured.

scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI state and NPC rapport, gifts, trade and rep effects; Level 11 and Level 10 quest libraries write their quest-step keys and shared player.state.quest tracker/payout.

places/home11/sim.js owns place.state.builtV, packed/moved tote props and the live h-fridge contents; scripts/interact.js persists fridge items to player.state.homeFridge, and home11-door.js owns door/TV/radio/lamp/microwave state and applies rest/food effects to the player.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; configured routing invokes scripts/routing.js.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; creator C uses scripts/wardrobe-ui.js to emit dress actions → scripts/critter.js writes player look/outfits.

Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom: accepted ctx.requestedRoomId preserves invited/portal/party rooms; otherwise derives solo room from normalized userId/username (guest fallback); engine out-of-bounds → sim.js handles respawn/routing.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs, writes arrival state.clipKind and calls companion.bring → nearby followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind into state.xfer.kind and scripts/noclip-ui.js renders transition.

places/level10/sim.js → terrain-relative Bumper Crop structures and usable farm props; use events enter scripts/level10-use.js ears.press, which updates player harvest/crafting/resources and quest state.

Level 10 lake and Level 7 sea/Level 11 canal rod casts: scripts/player.js swing path → scripts/lib/fishing.js validates canonical place-specific water, spawns scripts/bobber.js and stores fishingState → scheduled fish handlers resolve catch.

Level 11 l11-realty-agent dialogue → scripts/talk.js / scripts/lib/level11-quests.js asks and confirms house purchase, debits player.state.cents and writes player.state.home11; scripts/level11-use.js checks ownership at exterior door → enters home11.

places/home11/sim.js builds/version-rebuilds the home and loads the owner's saved homeFridge; usable object presses → scripts/home11-door.js ears.press for exit, swinging bedroom/bath doors, appliances, bed, and tote pack/place interactions.

h-fridge storage → scripts/interact.js openLoot and scripts/loot-ui.js TAKE/PUT IN; player.js pullToken removes deposited tokens, while interact.js updates fridge.state.items and player.state.homeFridge via saveKey.

Home TV channel presses read tv-channels.yml and update screen/audio/glow; boombox station/lamp switches update their object's audio or linked light; microwave consumes raw meat or non-drink snack then schedules home11-door.js ding to restore food/HP.

Level 8 spawnCamp, Level 21 survivor spawn and Level 10 Outpost sims author NPC rounds/ri → scripts/meg-agent.js drives route movement and idle/nearby-player reactions; chatter.yml supplies barks, and npc-starters.js/talk.yml supply NPC dialogue.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 carries portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js runs Boiler Room Death Rat packs.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office plan, cubicle/phone/printer variants, resident schedules and home claims; Level 7 has its own ocean and room systems.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat/social behavior; clothing/model helpers render characters.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml - recipes vary by category, costs, skill, bench and output; canonical weapon IDs connect recipe outputs to equip/combat/condition behavior.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles; rebuilds queue solids first and remove stale roots incrementally.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/data/level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits, l11-masonry/mall/sedco-shell and scripts/roadwork11.js - generated city/building forms reuse models and kits with seeded district, material and placement variations.

scripts/meg-agent.js routes use per-NPC rounds/ri at Level 8 camp, Level 2.1 survivors and Level 10 Outpost; stops vary by site and can specify dwell, look direction and animation, while shared reactions/barks depend on nearby player state.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state so ceiling checks survive ticks.
Level 2.1 ↔ Level 2, Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1, Level 6.1 ↔ Level 11, and Level 10 ↔ Level 11 paired arrivals are owned by level-door.js; Level 10's lake-deep trigger targets level7#l7-from-l10.

Level 10/184 configs use terrain10.js/terrain184.js heightmap and material queries; keep terrain-relative y placements and arrival/track regions aligned with sim scenery; Level 10 wheat decoration maxDistance is 120 m with 35 m fade.

Fishing casts use world-space positions, place-specific canonical water regions and height constants (Level 7 sea/parlor, Level 10 lake/pond, Level 11 canal); keep fishing.js checks aligned with sim geometry/water surfaces; bobbers are named by their fishing session.
Level 10 quest state is player.state.wheatQ/watcherQ/cellarQ (step 99 completed), plus wheat/flour/bread resource counts and pages; quest setters synchronize the shared player.state.quest HUD slot.

Home rebuilds use place.state.builtV (home11 V=34); preserve h-fridge.state.items, place.state.packed/moved and player.state.homeFridge sync; tote-packed props are omitted/recreated by stable IDs, and fridge saveKey relies on scripts/interact.js storage paths.
